name: Graphite Pulse
territory: Dark-UI-first system engineered for the product's existing dark default: a refined graphite neutral scale carrying a crisp electric mint-cyan 'pulse' as the single signal color — legible, technical, restrained. Light mode is a deliberately-designed companion, not a naive inversion.
dominanceRatio: 78% neutrals (graphite scale dominates in dark mode — this is a dark-first system) · 14% mint-pulse primary (CTAs, focus, active states, data highlights) · 8% semantic
primaryAppearsWhere: Primary CTA, focus rings, active nav/tab indicators, progress bars, key data highlights (e.g. a single stat callout), the loading-skeleton shimmer accent.
primaryMustNotAppearWhere: Never as a large background fill (an all-mint screen reads cheap/neon), never behind long-form Arabic result text, never as a border around generated Visual Studio images, never for error/destructive actions.
logoUsage: Context-dependent: white on the dark graphite background (primary default context, since this system is dark-first), black on white/light-neutral surfaces for print/light contexts. Logo remains strictly monochrome; the mint pulse never touches the mark itself.
